visual_review.inspected: All eight native-exported frames in the 2x contact sheet.
findings: Full helmet, both boots, cape and complete weapon remain inside each frame.
Windback, overhead preparation, strike extension, low follow-through and recovery are visually distinct.
Armor, tabard, sun motif and cape identity remain consistent.
Boot baselines are aligned to native y174; body movement comes from generated anatomy and cloth poses, not whole-image drift.
limits: The eight poses are generated animation keyframes with native refinement, not anatomically layered hand-painted animation.
GIF color approximation is documented separately from lossless native PNG/PXO exports.
No Godot in-game integration or playtest is claimed.
